summary: Tightened the vertical spacing between the timestamp and message text inside user bubbles by adding a 2px gap on the meta row and a -4px margin to cancel the copy button's reserved height in messages.css.
decisions: User message meta row uses a 2px gap (was relying on default spacing) and pulls up 4px to cancel the 26px copy button's reserved height, per the user's complaint that time and text were too far apart.
